verdict.rationale: Cline's documented CLI provides a headless mode for scripts and automation, with processable output. It supports an --auto-approve flag, accepts piped stdin input, and runs headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless script usage, and detailed docs on the output format and exit codes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
